items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: they had a fellow by the name of Albert Alexander. And he had a little group there and they used to build floats and all like that. And we used to play on the floats just like they did here.

ctx.x: What was Mardi Gras like over there when you were growing up?

Mardi Gras was one of them. In other words, they had a fellow by the name of Albert Alexander. And he had a little group there and they used to build floats and all like that. And we used to play on the floats just like they did here. But I mean, it was just a smaller group and everything. But every year they'd have about, if they didn't have but two, it was a big mardi Gras for us. Well, I remember hearing tales about Pastor Candy and that.
